race.description: Peter Walsh Member For Murray Plains Hcp (Bm52)
race.comment: PONTE ARCOBALENO (2) won't know himself back to BM52 grade. Was beaten 4.5 lengths last start, but that was by a horse from the McEvoy camp who should race through the grades and the only other horse that beat him home is a leading contender at Murtoa, so it looks a strong form race and he draws ideally. Ignore the fact STAND BY ME NED (14) is down the bottom of the page, because he's the highest-rated runner in this race. At his best over further, but was a model of consistency last prep and recent trial placing suggests she can turn in a run fresh from the low draw. NICKING GRACIE (7) will find this easier than the two runs back and should be at peak fitness now. ADKI (9) is a veteran who generally gives a sight on speed and will be suited here from the low draw. PIPPIE POMAR (6) is up in grade, but confidence is sky-high and shouldn't be underestimated.
